defects: Does not use NumberField.InfinitePlace; v and w are modeled as arbitrary fields rather than infinite places of number fields K, L
No LiesOver hypothesis (w.LiesOver v); replaced by an unrelated valuation-compatibility hypothesis h_extends that doesn't capture the 'lies over' relation on places
h_ramified (∃ ramification_index : ℕ, ramification_index = 2) is a vacuous/trivially true statement that does not formalize 'w.IsRamified K' (ramification of an infinite place) in any meaningful way
No Completion construction is used at all; the conclusion is stated directly on the fields v and w themselves rather than on their completions v.Completion and w.Completion
Uses Module.rank instead of Module.finrank, and applies it to the base fields rather than to completions, changing the mathematical content entirely
Overall the statement is a trivial/unrelated proposition that does not encode the informal theorem about ramified infinite places and completion degree
